title: Lightly Buttery Russian Fideo Pilaf
description: A classic Russian dish featuring fideo pasta, rest meat, and a dash of friendly spices, all combined in a lightly buttery pilaf.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Add the fideo pasta and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
